items.sEn: Ukraine's 3rd Separate Heavy Mechanised 'Iron' Brigade has released video of its 'Iron Birds' interceptor battery, part of the brigade's anti-aircraft missile battalion, which it says destroyed nine Russian Shahed attack drones in half a day. items.en: «Ланцети», «Орлани» і «Князь»: Пілоти Signum за ніч знищили 25 російських безпілотників різних типів (ArmyInform: Lancets, Orlans and 'Knyaz' – Signum pilots destroyed 25 Russian drones of various types overnight)
items.nl: Oekraïense drone-eenheid Signum meldt 25 Russische drones in één nacht neergehaald, onder meer Zala, Lancet en de nieuwe verkenner 'Knjaz Vesjtsji Oleg'
items.sEn: Ukrainian state outlet ArmyInform reports that drone pilots of the Signum unit of the 57th Separate Motorised Infantry Brigade shot down 25 Russian UAVs of various types during one night of 'air patrol' over Ukrainian territory, and released video of the engagements.
